name: Friedberg (Hesse, Germany)
description: Horizontally divided white over black, charged at the centre with the city arms of Friedberg (a black imperial eagle on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Friedberg; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Friedberg arms — black eagle on yellow
